description: This file defines the `SsoTokenProvider` class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for fetching, refreshing, and managing SSO tokens from the user's AWS SSO profiles. It handles profile resolution, token caching, refresh logic, and validation.

classes.name: SsoTokenProvider
classes.description: A class responsible for providing and managing AWS SSO tokens, including fetching, refreshing, and validating token data, based on user profiles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SsoTokenProvider with profile name, optional config file path, and optional SSO OIDC client for token operations.

methods.name: resolveProfileName
methods.description: Resolves the profile name based on constructor argument, environment variable, or defaults to 'default'.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Determines the config file path for the profile, defaulting to ~/.aws/config if not provided.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Async method to load and validate the cached SSO token, throwing exceptions if invalid or missing.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the SSO token if within refresh window and if possible, else returns current token data.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Determines if the token should be refreshed based on expiration and last refresh time.

methods.name: getTokenLocation
methods.description: Generates the file path for storing the token cache based on the SSO session name.

methods.name: getTokenData
methods.description: Reads and decodes the token data from the cache file.

methods.name: validateTokenData
methods.description: Validates the token data for required properties and expiration correctness.

methods.name: writeNewTokenDataToDisk
methods.description: Writes updated token data back to the cache file, updating the expiration timestamp.
